coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 11 ground-truth variable items (27%): ZB-2p scheduling with an ideal comparison, ideal versus actual execution analysis, and bubble rate measurement.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Replaces the fixed 16-stage, 64-microbatch experiment with a variable-stage and variable-microbatch grid. Omits the specified 14.6B model configuration, fixed global batch size, exact zero-bubble settings, and Nsight Systems/export/SVG workflow. Measuring communication overlap is not equivalent to assuming complete overlap in the theoretical calculation. Throughput in samples per second per GPU and explicit computed-versus-profiled timeline alignment are missing as outcomes. Additional baseline schedules do not replace these requirements.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to state that ZB-2p should achieve near-zero bubbles, generally below 1%, with minor real-execution overheads and supporting evidence from high throughput and tight theoretical-versus-profiled timeline alignment.
